Plasma Freeze

Released May 8, 2013 · 122 cards

Expanded

Plasma Freeze is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Black & White series, released in English on May 8, 2013. Its main set has 116 cards, plus 6 secret rares numbered beyond the set (122 in total). It includes 108 Pokémon, 13 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).
